correctness.rationale: For one excursion, Gaussian covariance integrated twice yields Var J(u)=v u^(2gamma), gamma=1+beta/2 and v=4K/((beta+1)(beta+2)). Thus completed rewards are tau^gamma times independent centered Gaussian with regular variation exponent p=alpha/gamma. Two-sided Pareto product tails and stable-domain attraction give exponent lambda=(t0^alpha E|xi|^p/m)*Gamma(1-p)cos(pi p/2), continuous value pi/2 at p=1. Finite-mean renewal N(t)/t->1/m and tight incomplete-age term transfer limit to clock t; exact sign symmetry removes centering. Renewal equation for conditional Gaussian second moment plus monotone Tauberian yields V t^(3+beta-alpha), so var(S(t)/t) scales t^(1+beta-alpha). Own analytic covariance integral and rational sample exponent checks agree. The assumptions beta in (0,2), alpha in (1,2), independent full renewal, and fixed Pareto cutoff are essential.
